data.description:
## Context / Problem
RP-01 is now landed on `origin/main`. It made `PydanticAIRunner.run()` -> one per-run `ProviderSession` -> one `_pai_structured`/Pydantic `Agent` operation authoritative and pinned request-budget, output repair, cache, exhaustion, artifact, tracing, usage, and failure behavior. RP-04 must add provider-native auth injection without forking that path.

## Outcome
Add an `LLMRuntime` capability assembled at the trusted operation boundary and consumed only by existing `ProviderSession` builders. Accept provider-native pre-client auth/session capabilities (for example boto3 Session, Anthropic access-token provider, OpenAI callable/workload identity, or provider-specific static input); Rebar still constructs/owns/closes the official client and retains RP-01 policy. Arbitrary constructed clients/runners and a second Agent/retry scheduler remain out of scope.

## Plan
1. Add typed provider-specific auth/session fields to the runtime-binding module. Keep them non-serializable and outside `LLMConfig`, `RunRequest`, snapshots, fingerprints, caches, CLI/MCP schemas, and public output.
2. Extend `PydanticAIRunner`/`get_runner` to receive `LLMRuntime`, then pass it into the one per-run `ProviderSession`. Enrich only the existing Anthropic/Bedrock/OpenAI builder inputs; preserve fallback candidate construction and close ownership.
3. Let each official SDK retain native precedence, refresh, expiry, invalidation, and workload identity. If explicit provider/auth composition is missing or conflicting, fail before a provider model request and never try another ambient principal/provider. Optional observability remains separate.
4. Do not alter `_pai_structured`, output policy, request allowance, complete-or-omit failed-response history, cache breakpoint/settings/accounting, typed exhaustion, final artifacts, candidate tracing, usage normalization, failure translation, or documented limit-raise guidance.

## Test design (RED -> GREEN)
- Extend provider construction unit tests with native capability doubles for Anthropic, Bedrock, and OpenAI; assert the exact existing builder receives the capability, one official client is constructed/closed, and no raw token extraction occurs outside its adapter.
- Run RP-01's S2/S3/S5 authoritative offline oracles and candidate-tracing oracle unchanged. Add an AST/runtime guard that auth injection still has one `ProviderSession`, one runner dispatch, and one Agent operation.
- Failure tests cover absent/conflicting explicit auth, revoked static auth, native refresh success, refresh failure, fallback candidates, transport retry, output retry/exhaustion, and secret canary leakage.
- [operator-attested] Run bounded live Anthropic and Bedrock auth/cache canaries after cutover. Record provider/auth-source kind, cache read/write counters, request/retry counts, trace/run id, timestamp, and redacted outcome; never record credential material.

## Compatibility / rollback
Runtime input is optional during expansion; absence delegates to the exact RP-01 construction behavior. Before callers require the binding, rollback removes the new argument. After cutover, rollback must retain an adapter accepting the binding but may ignore it in favor of the old native environment chain. No LLM result schema changes.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Anthropic, Bedrock, and OpenAI construction tests prove provider-native capability reaches only the existing `ProviderSession` builder and exactly one Rebar-owned official client lifecycle.
- [ ] The unchanged RP-01 authoritative S2/S3/S5 and candidate-tracing suites pass, including one-Agent budget, complete-or-omit retry history, cache/accounting, typed exhaustion, artifacts, tracing, usage, and failure contracts.
- [ ] Structural/runtime tests reject a second runner/client owner, Agent construction route, `_pai_structured` caller, or bespoke retry scheduler.
- [ ] Missing/conflicting explicit auth fails before a provider model request without anonymous, alternate-principal, or cross-provider fallback; native refresh remains SDK-owned.
- [ ] Secret sentinels are absent from config/request/snapshot/fingerprint/cache/schema/output/log/exception/tracing boundaries and unwrap only inside the selected provider builder.
- [ ] [operator-attested] Bounded live Anthropic and Bedrock auth/cache canaries pass with the required redacted evidence recorded on this ticket.
data.title: RP-04 S4 — Inject LLM auth through the landed ProviderSession
